trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 140 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 0.1 relative to the lobe chord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; irregular, low-amplitude peaks and valleys (3-7 pixels in depth) create a jagged profile from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trajectory follows a convex curve from the notch, sweeping upward and outward to form distinct, slightly hooked points at the distal ends.
